note: Hand-written from verified live-site copy (category pages and tour introductions). No sightings guaranteed; wording uses 'known for' / 'home to'.

destinations.name: Maasai Mara National Reserve
destinations.excerpt: Kenya's most famous reserve — sweeping savannah known for big cats, large herds and the July-to-October wildebeest migration river crossings.

destinations.name: Amboseli National Park
destinations.excerpt: Famous for large elephant herds on open plains with iconic views of Mount Kilimanjaro across the border.

destinations.name: Lake Nakuru National Park
destinations.excerpt: Rift Valley lake park known for rhinos, birdlife and beautiful lakeshore scenery.

destinations.name: Lake Naivasha
destinations.excerpt: Freshwater Rift Valley lake offering boat rides, Crescent Island walks and calm contrast to the big savannah parks.

destinations.name: Samburu National Reserve
destinations.excerpt: Rugged northern reserve with species rarely seen further south, including Grevy's zebra, reticulated giraffe and gerenuk.

destinations.name: Aberdare National Park
destinations.excerpt: Isolated volcanic range of misty forests, waterfalls and moorland — a cool highland contrast to the savannah.

destinations.name: Tsavo East National Park
destinations.excerpt: Vast open wilderness known for large elephant herds dusted red by the park's distinctive soil.

destinations.name: Tsavo West National Park
destinations.excerpt: Volcanic landscapes, lava flows and the Mzima Springs underwater hippo viewing hide.

destinations.name: Lake Bogoria National Reserve
destinations.excerpt: Alkaline lake famous for flamingo gatherings, hot springs and geysers along its shores.

destinations.name: Ol Pejeta Conservancy (Sweetwaters)
destinations.excerpt: Private conservancy known for rhino conservation, including northern white rhinos, plus Big Five game drives.

destinations.name: Serengeti National Park
destinations.excerpt: Endless plains at the heart of the wildebeest migration, with big cats especially easy to see.

destinations.name: Ngorongoro Crater
destinations.excerpt: The world's largest intact volcanic caldera — a natural enclosure with dense wildlife including all of the Big Five.

destinations.name: Tarangire National Park
destinations.excerpt: River park dotted with ancient baobabs, known for large elephant herds in the dry season.

destinations.name: Lake Manyara National Park
destinations.excerpt: Compact park of groundwater forest, lake and escarpment — famous for tree-climbing lions, elephants and birdlife.

destinations.name: Nairobi
destinations.excerpt: The safari capital — national park, elephant orphanage, giraffe centre, museums and culture, all within one city.

destinations.name: Mount Kilimanjaro
destinations.excerpt: Africa's highest peak — a trekking destination with routes to Uhuru Peak through five climate zones.
